findings.finding: A-P1 records 8 research access operations: 7 web_run operations and one github_fetch_issue operation. B-P2 records 13 web_run operations because five same-document line opens were added. Those five accesses do not create five extra originals, but they are real recorded access work.
findings.implication: Equal query/slot/original upper bounds are supported. Equal realized research calls, reading volume, monetary cost or time are not supported. Local hash/file utilities are outside these research-operation totals.

findings.finding: A-P1-S05 is the 4.6.x edition of the document family already read as A-P1-S03. Its fifth access was charged, and no replacement original was opened. Thus five source/edition IDs were read, but only four document families and two recorded independent lineages.
findings.implication: Do not report five independent originals or three distinct useful components merely because three A rank rows have the component classification. The official manual lineage is counted once.

findings.finding: A-P1 Q1/R1 and Q2/R1 record automatic exposure of the target issue and a #19648 pointer outside the issue body. Q3/R1 records target-body re-exposure. The ledgers contain no explicit comment-body or linked-PR-body access.
findings.implication: Retain the recorded blinding failure despite frozen queries and the lack of an explicit PR fetch. The issue re-read is prior/problem evidence, not discovery of a new solution. B records no recognized target/comment/solution exposure; lack of recognition is not proof that no unrecognized exposure occurred.

findings.finding: A's three responses contained 19+22+16=57 blocks; 42 were outside the 15 trial slots. B contained 18+18+18=54 blocks; 39 were outside the 15 trial slots.
findings.implication: The extra blocks were not counted as directly read originals or trial hits. Their automatic snippet exposure still belongs in the limitations. Without raw response review, this audit cannot independently certify their contents or exclusion behavior.

findings.finding: A marks5 rank positions as direct_read and10 as uninspected. Four of those10 point to a source read at an earlier rank, so9 rank positions refer to a read source. The distinct-source denominator remains5/11, and the recorded-lineage read denominator remains2/4. B has5 directly read sources out of13 and5 rank positions referring to those sources.
findings.implication: The wording uninspected10 in A describes no new access charged at those positions. It must not be interpreted as ten distinct unread documents. Reused read-source appearances cannot raise the independent-read numerator.

findings.finding: Both scoped arm records have zero accepted complete-solution rows. A's two contradict statuses concern the author's reported existing faulty implementation; its other28 condition statuses are unknown. All30 B condition statuses are unknown.
findings.implication: Component/principle labels do not mean C1/C2 were established. This audit does not adjudicate those labels, source passages or proposed transfers because originals were not opened.

findings.finding: This snapshot subset contains A for P1 and B for P2. It contains zero complete within-problem A/B pairs.
findings.implication: The table diagnoses cost accounting and adherence only. It cannot estimate A-only/B-only/common/both-fail counts, relative effectiveness, time savings or equal-cost causal performance.

limits: All trial records were read with git show from 649638c731e7f2c71c8c993bb0f9af9e0924fb79; queries were read from 03d1e436cfa7dc209b57b19508ef4b2e75942824. Live arm files, later appended problems and later format cleanup were not read.

Lineage identity, edition equivalence, authorship and section claims were checked for internal consistency only. Their substantive truth needs original-source review.

B's duplicate mirror handling resolves its three uninspected Internet-Draft URLs to one source/lineage. Since it was not read or counted, this does not add to the directly read denominator.
